## Checklist

- [ ] I reserved the id in `registry/ids.json` with my GitHub login (new machines) or I am the owner it is reserved to
- [ ] `python3 tools/check.py machines/<id>/<version>` passes
- [ ] The version is higher than every published one; I did not edit any published file
- [ ] The manifest has the licence of the machine (SPDX) and an author handle (no real name or e-mail needed)
- [ ] If I added a `preview/` folder: 1 to 8 `.mp3` files, at most 2 MB each, audio I may share
- [ ] The README says what it does, the knobs and credits
- [ ] I understand this is native code with no sandbox and is listed as community, not tested by Sidecar
